title: MAKUPAC s.r.o. — Logistics & Fulfillment DD
context: Czech fulfillment & logistics company (3PL sector). 91% concentrated control held by Petr Kuchyňka (36 y/o). Severe client concentration: 60-80% revenue from single customer (Zapakuj Shop s.r.o.). Active operation with strong unit economics (~15% EBITDA margin, above industry 8-15%) but catastrophic dependency risks. Industry tailwind: Czech 3PL market growing >5% CAGR.
